title: Price manipulation in nonlinear transient impact models: rigidity before memory and complete positivity after memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.02447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transient impact models compose a nonlinearity with a memory kernel, and the order of composition determines the criterion for absence of price manipulation. We classify both orders. If an arbitrary instantaneous law $f$ acts on the trading rate before any nonzero integrable Volterra kernel, nonnegative cost on every finite piecewise-constant round trip forces $f$ to be affine, and linear for every nonzero convolution kernel. In particular, the power law $\mathrm{sgn}(x)|x|^\delta$, $\delta>0$, combined with power-law decay $t^{-\gamma}$, $0<\gamma<1$, admits manipulation if and only if $\delta\ne1$: square-root impact is manipulable at every decay exponent, and the region left open by Gatheral's slow-rate two-block bound $\delta+\gamma\ge1$ collapses to the line $\delta=1$. translated_title: 非线性暂态冲击模型中的价格操纵：记忆之前的刚性与记忆之后的完全正性
translated_abstract: 暂态冲击模型将非线性函数与记忆核复合，复合的先后顺序决定了无价格操纵的判据。本文对两种顺序都进行了分类。如果任意瞬时冲击规律 f 在任何非零可积 Volterra 核之前作用于交易速率，那么要在每个有限的分段常数往返交易上成本非负，就迫使 f 必须是仿射的；而对于每个非零卷积核，f 则必须是线性的。特别地，幂律冲击 sgn(x)|x|^δ（δ>0）与幂律衰减 t^(-γ)（0<γ<1）相结合时，当且仅当 δ≠1 才存在操纵：也就是说，平方根冲击在每一个衰减指数下都是可操纵的，而 Gatheral 慢速率两块界 δ+γ≥1 所留下的开区域坍缩为直线 δ=1。早期的刚性定理要求记忆核在零点处有界；而本文的论证是一个零成交量的高频颤动泵，由两笔极小的基准交易来读取其效应……
tldr: 本文对非线性暂态冲击模型中非线性冲击函数与记忆核的两种复合顺序给出了完整的无操纵判据：非线性先于记忆核作用时，无操纵要求瞬时冲击律必须是仿射的（因而平方根冲击在任何衰减指数下均可被操纵，只有线性冲击免于操纵），而记忆核先于非线性作用时，无操纵的判据则是核的完全正性。
en_tdlr: This paper fully classifies absence of price manipulation in nonlinear transient impact models by composition order: when the instantaneous law acts before memory, nonnegative round-trip cost forces it to be affine (so square-root impact is manipulable at every decay exponent and only linear impact is safe), whereas when memory acts first the criterion is complete positivity of the kernel.
